query:
INSERT INTO user_tokens (token_hash, user_id, purpose, expires_at)
         SELECT $1, $2, $3, now() + make_interval(secs => $4)
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM user_tokens
             WHERE user_id = $2 AND purpose = $3
               AND created_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $5)
         )
